Messages.Body:

Philipp

Not unless they also do damage based on the striking minion's hand strikes.

It is impossible to strike with anything other than a hand strike after

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Philipp Helle wrote:

> do "Strike: Combat" ends and "Strike:Dodge" count as hand strikes?
> Or is it impossible to dodge after an Immortal Grapple has been played?

Strike: Combat Ends and Strike: Dodge are not hand strikes.

p 41 of CE rulebook--(6.4.5): "Hand Strikes: The default strike is a hand
strike. When a minion strikes with a hand strike at close range, he does an
amount of damage equal to his strength to the opposing minion. Minions have
a default strength of 1."

S:CE and S:D don't do this, and thus aren't hand strikes.

Pretty much the whole point of Immortal Grapple is that it stops S:CE and
Strike Dodge.
